objective: Establish a leakage-safe, evidence-backed method to assess and improve the daily report's forecast precision without claiming predictive edge prematurely.

checks.description: Audit frozen source reports and ledger rows for mature outcomes, horizons, source comparability, missingness and leakage constraints.
Predefine leakage-safe metrics, at least two simple baselines, and a minimum evidence threshold or explain why no comparison is yet defensible.
Registered Trader reviews interpretability and limitations of Moomoo directional inputs for the proposed forecast comparison.
Lead records model-change, evidence-accumulation or abstention recommendation and exact next scope.

acceptance.description: Establish available forecast/outcome cohort counts, target horizons, missingness and comparability limits.
Define leakage-safe metrics, at least two simple baselines, and an evidence/sample threshold or evidence-based reason to defer comparison.
Record Trader's review of Moomoo signal interpretability and data limitations.
Record Lead's recommendation and next exact implementation scope without implying production changes.
